snippet.title: Triangle - Cursed Town Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description:
Triangle Cursed Town is a co-op multiplayer horror game where you and your friends must uncover the secrets of a haunted village. Work together to collect evidence, survive terrifying encounters, and perform rituals to banish a supernatural entity. Every match features procedurally generated maps, unique items, and unpredictable monster behavior, making each session a fresh and suspenseful experience.

🕯️ Gather clues, solve mysteries, and face your fears as a team.
🧩 Multiple entity types, dynamic objectives, and challenging rituals.
🌑 Inspired by folklore, blending classic horror with modern co-op gameplay.

Available soon on Steam Early Access!
